hooks.name: Security Scan on Dependency Change
hooks.description: Audits dependencies for vulnerabilities when package files change

action.prompt: A dependency file was modified. Remind the developer to run: 1) npm audit (for frontend/package.json changes) or 2) pip-audit (for backend/pyproject.toml changes). Check that new dependencies are well-maintained, have no known critical CVEs, and are justified with clear technical value.
